title: done's ledger check does not see a source id the goal writes joined by a hyphen, such as S100-related or S100-S120
goal: bl_land's goal tokens name a source id written with a hyphen or underscore joined to it (S100-related, S100-S120), so done does not refuse rows of a source the goal names (SP-7nv2ffr2 review).

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_land
w = bl_land.cited_tokens(".", {}, ["Refresh S100-related facts", "Keep the S200-S220 rows", "Rows of S300_old"])
miss = sorted({"S100", "S200", "S220", "S300"} - w)
print("goal tokens missing:", miss)
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

gates.question: How does cited_tokens name a source id joined by a hyphen or underscore: add the parts of every token split at - and _, or match source-id shapes (S plus digits) inside tokens?

match only source-id shapes inside tokens
gates.recommendation: split every token at hyphen and underscore
